title: Patient Quality of Life Following Pulmonary Embolism Response Team Intervention: A Subanalysis of the EXPERT DACH-Registry
summary:
Non-interventional, prospective, comparative registry study without randomization.
The aim is to evaluate patient-reported outcome measures (PROMs) over a one-year period after PERT intervention and to analyze these outcomes in conjunction with clinical data from the main registry.

interventions.name:
Patients diagnosed with pulmonary embolism (PE) who received treatment decisions guided by the involvement of a pulmonary embolism response team (PERT) and participate in the EXPERT DACH-Registry.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
- Participant of the EXPERT DACH-Registry
- Ownership of a mobile device
Exclusion criteria:
- Unwillingness to complete PROM questionnaires
